senses.gloss: m. (infin. of יְקַד) burning, setting on fire.
units: R. Hash. 22ᵇ מאי משמע רהאי משיאין לישנא רי׳ הוא what evidence is there that the word massiin (Mish.

<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 2:2">ib. II, 2</cite>) has the meaning of burning (a signal fire)? Answ.: ref. to <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 5:21">Targ. II Sam. V, 21</cite>, v. <cite ref="J00566"><he>יְקֵד</he></cite>. [The passage is missing in Mss.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note.]
